criteria.reason: Pending apps/web/tests/post-m1-phase-6-files-diffs-search-worktrees.redspec.ts, which will spy on the real API request and resulting canonical attachment to prove missing capability 2.

criteria.reason: Pending the Phase 6 API contract and live React specs, which will exercise the negative worktree-selection boundary.

criteria.text: Hard delete with canonical `removeWorktree:true` does not return 204 or broadcast `session.removed` while engine removal has returned or thrown 400/false and any nonce registry entry, directory, or branch ref remains; the failure retains durable worktree identity sufficient for a bounded retry.
criteria.reason: Executed with Vitest on 2026-08-15. The real HTTP controller called removeWorktree, received false, and failed the contract assertion because DELETE /agent-sessions/:id/hard returned 204. This reproduces the owned false-success defect; the failure was AssertionError: false engine cleanup must not be reported as HTTP 204 success: expected 204 not to be 204.

criteria.text: A successful hard delete with `removeWorktree:true` removes the local session and messages, SDK session and descendants, in-memory mapping, stream/listener state, nonce worktree registry entry, exact directory, and exact branch ref before returning 204 exactly once.
criteria.reason: Pending apps/api_server/src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_6_cleanup_live_e2e.test.ts, which will assert every state boundary instead of trusting status 204.

criteria.text: If worktree removal partially succeeds before branch deletion fails, cleanup reports failure, records the remaining exact branch ref, and a bounded retry removes that orphan without recreating or deleting any worktree directory.
criteria.reason: Pending apps/api_server/src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_6_cleanup_live_e2e.test.ts, which will mutation-inject the fork's registry/filesystem/branch split and prove recoverability.

criteria.text: Pass, timeout, cancel, assertion failure, provider failure, API failure, and engine failure paths all execute idempotent `finally` cleanup and leave zero nonce database rows, files, listeners, sockets, worktree registry entries, worktree directories, and branch refs.
criteria.reason: Pending apps/api_server/src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_6_cleanup_live_e2e.test.ts, whose cleanup helper will be forced through every plan-c4 exit path.

criteria.text: Before and after every cleanup scenario, the exact pre-existing `git worktree list --porcelain`, pre-existing worktree directories, and pre-existing branch refs are unchanged; cleanup targets only names and paths created by that test run.
criteria.reason: Pending apps/api_server/src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_6_cleanup_live_e2e.test.ts, which will snapshot and compare the three independent Git state systems.

criteria.text: Running cleanup twice after complete success is a no-op success, while running it after an incomplete failure retries only the recorded residue; neither path emits duplicate `session.removed` frames or deletes a reused/non-owned branch name.
criteria.reason: Pending apps/api_server/src/__tests__/post_m1_phase_6_cleanup_live_e2e.test.ts, which will prove idempotence and exact ownership under retry.
